tasks.solution: «Last year» требует Past Simple; buy — неправильный глагол, форма прошедшего времени — bought.

tasks.text:

tasks.text:

tasks.solution: Слово «elephant» начинается со звука гласного, поэтому используется артикль an.

tasks.text: Заполни пропуски предлогами: at, in, on, from, with, to (один лишний). 1) The train leaves ___ eight o'clock. 2) They travelled ___ July, during the school holidays. 3) The museum is closed ___ Mondays. 4) This postcard is ___ my friend in Saint Petersburg. 5) Oleg walked around the park ___ his sister.
tasks.solution: Лишний предлог — to. 1) точное время — at; 2) месяцы — in; 3) дни недели — on; 4) отправитель — from; 5) совместное действие — with.

tasks.text: Какое слово лишнее? train, bus, car, bicycle, river

tasks.text: Какое слово лишнее? beautiful, old, small, tired, museum
tasks.solution: Beautiful, old, small и tired — прилагательные, а museum — существительное.

tasks.text: Какое слово лишнее? Monday, Tuesday, Friday, Sunday, June
tasks.solution: Monday, Tuesday, Friday и Sunday — дни недели, а June — месяц.

tasks.text: Какое слово лишнее? bigger, smaller, older, better, taller
tasks.solution: Bigger, smaller, older и taller образованы правильно (+er), а better — исключение (good — better).

tasks.text: Прочитай письмо от друга по переписке. Ответь на все его вопросы, как в письме-ответе (1-3 предложения на каждый вопрос).
tasks.answer:
Dear Alice,
Thank you for your letter! My family is quite small — I live with my mum and my little brother. On Sundays, I usually go to the swimming pool with my dad and then we watch a film in the evening. My favourite subject is Art because I love drawing animals. I hope your piano lessons are going well!
Best wishes,
Sonya

tasks.text:
Прослушай текст и выбери номера 5 верных утверждений из 8:
1) Denis turned eight years old yesterday.
2) Denis's party was in the morning.
3) Denis liked his new bicycle best of all his presents.
4) There were more sweets than fruit at the party.
5) Denis's friends came to his flat for the party.
6) Denis wants to ride his bicycle with his mum next weekend.
7) Their mum made a chocolate cake with strawberries.
8) Denis and his friends played games and sang songs.
tasks.solution: 1 — текст: «He turned eight years old». 3 — текст: «he liked his new bicycle best». 5 — текст: «Denis's friends came to our flat for a party». 7 — текст: «our mum made a big chocolate cake with strawberries on top». 8 — текст: «They played games and sang songs».
tasks.audio: Yesterday was my brother Denis's birthday. He turned eight years old. In the morning, our mum made a big chocolate cake with strawberries on top. In the afternoon, Denis's friends came to our flat for a party. They played games and sang songs. Denis got a lot of presents, but he liked his new bicycle best. He doesn't like sweets very much, so there were more fruit and juice than sweets at the party. Next weekend, Denis wants to ride his new bicycle in the park with our dad.

tasks.text:
Statement: "Pushok's cage is near the window."
Это утверждение верно (True), неверно (False) или в тексте не сказано (Not Stated)?
tasks.solution: Текст: «Pushok lives in a big cage near the window».
tasks.reading: Class 4A has got a pet hamster called Pushok. Pushok lives in a big cage near the window. Every day, a different student takes care of him — this week it is a girl named Olya. Olya gives Pushok fresh water and small pieces of carrot or apple. Pushok sleeps during the day and becomes active in the evening, which sometimes surprises the students who stay late for the after-school club. Last month, the class hamster escaped from his cage for a few hours, and everyone helped look for him. They finally found him behind a cupboard. Now the teacher checks the cage door every afternoon before the students go home. The children don't feed Pushok chocolate because it is dangerous for hamsters.

tasks.text:
Вставь пропущенное слово: "Be quiet! The baby ___ in the next room."
1) sleep 2) sleeps 3) is sleeping 4) slept
tasks.solution: Ситуация происходит прямо сейчас — нужен Present Continuous.

tasks.text:

1) clean 2) cleans 3) cleaned 4) cleaning
tasks.solution: «On Monday» (в контексте прошедшего события) требует Past Simple; clean — правильный глагол, форма прошедшего времени — cleaned.

tasks.text:
Вставь пропущенное слово: "This cage is small, but the old one was even ___."
1) small 2) smaller 3) smallest 4) more small
tasks.solution: Слово «even» перед прилагательным сигнализирует о сравнительной степени — smaller.

tasks.text:

1) There is 2) There are 3) There has 4) There be

1) a 2) an 3) the 4) -

tasks.text: Заполни пропуски предлогами: in, at, on, for, with, from (один лишний). 1) Olya feeds the hamster ___ the morning. 2) The after-school club starts ___ four o'clock. 3) The children take care of Pushok ___ Mondays. 4) Olya bought a small toy ___ her hamster. 5) Pushok likes to play ___ his food bowl.
tasks.solution: Лишний предлог — from. 1) часть дня — in; 2) точное время — at; 3) дни недели — on; 4) цель/получатель — for; 5) взаимодействие с предметом — with.

tasks.text: Какое слово лишнее? hamster, rabbit, parrot, cat, wolf

tasks.text: Какое слово лишнее? feed, clean, escape, sleep, dangerous
tasks.solution: Feed, clean, escape и sleep — глаголы, а dangerous — прилагательное.

tasks.text: Какое слово лишнее? carrot, apple, water, chocolate, football
tasks.solution: Carrot, apple, water и chocolate можно есть или пить, а football нельзя.

tasks.text: Какое слово лишнее? boxes, foxes, dishes, wishes, cats
tasks.solution: Boxes, foxes, dishes и wishes образуют множественное число через -es (слова оканчиваются на -x или -sh), а cats — просто через -s.
